english.note: Use 領先 when a person or team is at the front in a race, contest, or ranking.
This is the all-purpose choice for being ahead of competitors, and it is also used in the fixed term 領先指標 for a leading indicator.

examples.english: Our team is at the front of the rankings right now.
examples.traditional: 我哋隊喺排名榜上面領先緊。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 deoi6 hai2 paai4 ming4 bong2 soeng6 min6 ling5 sin1 gan2

examples.english: We were leading throughout this match.
examples.traditional: 今場比賽我哋一直領先。
